build.dockerfile:
# Default test environment for this starter; customize it for your project.
# For reproducible environments replace the base tag with an approved image digest.
FROM python:3.13-slim
RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git bash tar nodejs \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
